# `{javascripting}`

A demo Shiny app showing progressive development of various R shiny features utilising Javascript. The intent is to not only show what is possible with Javascript but also to teach users how the Javascript code works.

## Features

Current features include:
- Utilising Javascript to embed checkboxes within DT tables.

In all features, a version by version process is provided to show gradual progression from the starting point, to a full functioning feature with Javascript code.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `{javascripting}` like so:

```{r}
remotes::install_github("alisontelford/javascripting")
```

## Launch the App

You can launch the application by running:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
javascripting::run_app()
```

## Documentation
- Stepwise version explanations and code samples are available in-app.
- All JavaScript assets are in `inst/app/www/`.
- See `R/mod_embedded_checkbox_in_table.R` for modular server/UI patterns.

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please submit PRs to the GitHub repository.
